[[ ## draft ## ]]
{"to": ["Frank Osei"], "subject": "Re: Margins on the last job", "body": "Frank,

Thanks for the note. I dug into the job file this morning and pulled the line-by-line breakdown you asked for.

Here’s the short version: we lost it on labor. The budgeted hours came in about 18% over what we estimated, and the overtime premium on the last two weeks pushed that line item further. Materials were close to plan—within 2%—and equipment rental actually came in under. So the culprit is labor, specifically the rework on the foundation pour that wasn’t in the original takeoff.

I’ll have the full schedule attached to the shared drive by end of day, broken down by phase and crew. If you want, I can also run a quick variance analysis against the last three similar-size projects to see if this is a pattern or a one-off.

Let me know if you’d like me to walk you through it before the huddle.

Des", "summary": "Provides Frank with a line-by-line margin breakdown, attributing the shortfall to labor overruns and overtime, with materials near plan. Commits to sharing a detailed schedule on the drive by end of day and offers a variance analysis against prior projects."}
